description: Training arguments of the runs whose evaluation JSON files carry no 'args' field, read once (read-only, CPU) from the original checkpoints restored from the backup of the training machine: ckpt.pt keys 'args' (vars of the training script's argparse namespace), 'model_args', 'params' and 'train_time' (seconds). null = no checkpoint available. Used by paper/build/make_supplement.sh to write run_args/runs.csv, so that rebuilding the supplement needs no access to the checkpoints.
